items.html: And it is known that in every lower one the upper one expands in order to give it life, and the lower one does not expand into the upper one from which it comes. Therefore the force of Atik Yomin is present in the seven lower Nekudot, whereas the force of AA, of AVI, and of ZON is not mingled in the three first Nekudot, which are all the discernment of Atik.
